en.text:
Class Ability usage grants 6.25% increased Sprint Speed for 10 seconds. Duration is not refreshable.

Sprinting grants the following benefits: 
• 1 stack of <stasis/>Frost Armor every <pve 3 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds
• <pve 100% /> <pvp [200%] /> Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• <pve Doubled /> <pvp [100% Additional] /> Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate

For as long as <stasis/>Frost Armor is active, you are granted <pve x3 /> <pvp [x1] /> Stasis Weapon Surge. 

Multiplicative Ability Regeneration Rate increase in PVE is applied after all additive Ability Regeneration Rate modifiers.
